services.name: Farm stand
services.blurb: Picked at first light, cooled and washed, on the stand table by ten.

services.name: CSA shares
services.blurb: A box every week for twelve weeks, half or full, with a note on cooking it.

services.name: Pick-your-own strawberries & peaches
services.blurb: Strawberries in April, peaches in June. We text the morning the rows are ready.

services.name: Seasonal produce
services.blurb: Tomatoes, okra, squash, field peas and sweet potatoes, each in its own Midlands month.

services.name: Pasture-raised eggs
services.blurb: Hens moved to fresh grass each week, eggs gathered before eight every morning.

services.name: Grass-fed beef
services.blurb: Quarters and halves, wrapped and labelled by cut, picked up on a set Saturday.

services.name: Raw honey
services.blurb: Strained only, from hives at the edge of the peach rows, spring and summer jars.

services.name: Restaurant & caterer orders
services.blurb: A standing weekly order packed your way, with a Tuesday text if something runs short.

services.name: Farm tours
services.blurb: An hour in the rows, the hen pasture and the wash shed, for families and classes.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We got to the stand at 9:40 on a Saturday in June and the peaches were still cool from the cooler. My daughter ate two in the truck before we were off the gravel.
reviews.name: Henrietta V.

reviews.text: I was nervous about a CSA after one that buried us in kale. The half share here was tomatoes, okra, squash and one bunch of greens, with a note on how to cook them. We held two weeks for the beach with one text.
reviews.name: Leopold F.

reviews.text: Eggs gathered before eight and you can tell. The yolks stand up in the pan. We grab a dozen every Wednesday on the way to work.
reviews.name: Pilar N.

reviews.text: Odessa texted Friday night that the strawberries were thin and to come Sunday instead. We did, and filled two gallons in forty minutes with the kids.
reviews.name: Reggie H.

reviews.text: Bought a quarter of beef for our chest freezer. It came wrapped and labelled by cut, and they explained hanging weight without making me feel dumb for asking twice.
reviews.name: Lorraine B.

reviews.text: I run a small lunch counter in Cayce. The Thursday order shows up packed the way I asked, and when the okra ran short they told me on Tuesday, not at the back door.
reviews.name: Cornelius J.

proof.guarantee: If something in your CSA box is not right, tell us by Sunday and it is replaced in the next box.
